premises.text: Existing databases only store, organize, and look up data; applications need the database itself to be smarter
premises.evidence_span: if everyone's already building things on databases, what if we were to make the actual database itself a lot smarter?

premises.text: Veritable is a predictive database that understands data and predicts missing values via a SQL-like PREDICT interface
premises.evidence_span: Veritable is a predictive database that lets you, if you know how to talk to a database

premises.text: Same ML works across domains (dating, disease/symptoms, customers/products, voting/surveys) so apps need not hand-build intelligence
premises.evidence_span: It also works across application domains

premises.text: Nonparametric Bayesian / MCMC engine lets non-data-scientists get predictions with confidence intervals without understanding the math
premises.evidence_span: We've built state-of-the-art nonparametric Bayesian statistics powered by Markov chain Monte Carlo so that no one in this audience ever has to worry about what those words mean ever again

premises.text: If you can use SQL you can use Veritable—targeting the large population of SQL-literate developers
premises.evidence_span: if you can use SQL, you can use Veritable

value.text: Any developer can build intelligent applications that fill blanks and forecast with confidence without hiring data science or doing math
value.evidence_span: let everyone in the audience actually build this class of application

causal_links.evidence_span: instead of just looking things up, it actually tells you interesting things
Veritable makes it this easy to actually predict missing values
every database user out there should be able to use Veritable

notes: Lookup-only DB limitation as problem. Predictive DB + PREDICT syntax, cross-domain examples, and no-math Bayesian engine folded as product cascade (§4.1.7). SQL-user adoption as GTM. Demo dating app is illustration not separate premise. Oracle/Yahoo employee counts as framing. Three domains—anti-template.
